name: @ritmika/ui-distiller
description: Behavioral UI distillation compiler using Playwright and Chrome DevTools Protocol.

scripts.capture: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js capture
scripts.capture-action: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js capture-action
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js doctor
scripts.recording-to-flow: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js recording-to-flow
scripts.compile: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js compile
scripts.graph: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js graph
scripts.diff: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js diff
scripts.unified-spec: npm run build && node dist/src/canonical-cli.js unified-spec
